kind: retrospective analysis; no new performance samples

primary_decision.target: large R9, fixed v2 requested=24 vs original best tested team
primary_decision.policy: 5% median total-time reduction and interval supports benefit; not a universal performance promise

one_condition_per_matrix_T12.rule: screen/heldout/large; original vs v2-auto; large R9 only; other R as recorded
one_condition_per_matrix_T12.interpretation: descriptive median thresholds, not significance tests or a user workload distribution

cautions: total is median of each process P+E+cleanup; component medians need not sum to it
only the original large experiment has adjacent randomized process pairs and paired intervals
local linear break-even illustrations reuse E/R at the measured R; startup/cache/R changes invalidate extrapolation
no finite illustrative break-even if measured optimized execute median is not faster
v2 heldout inputs are now development evidence for v2.1, not new v2.1 holdout inputs
